`staff_badges` is the list of badges: who holds each one, and their `role`.
text:

note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · the gazette's subheadline

source:
3 members of staff at Hopital Lamarck were attacked this week. Each was alone in a room at the back of the building. None of them saw the attacker.

Each one had just taken morphine from the hospital's Drug Reserve. The attacker took it. Every staff door in the building reads a badge.
text:
3 miembros del personal de Hopital Lamarck fueron atacados esta semana. Cada uno estaba solo en una sala del fondo del edificio. Ninguno vio al agresor.

Cada uno acababa de sacar morfina de la reserva de medicamentos (`Drug Reserve`) del hospital. El agresor se la quitó. Cada puerta del personal del edificio lee una tarjeta.

source: THE 3 STATEMENTS
text: LAS 3 DECLARACIONES
note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · document `statements` — title

source:
**Amira Saleh, Monday `2026-02-02`.** Around 15:30 I took morphine from the `Drug Reserve`. Then I went into the `Supply Room` alone. A few minutes later I heard the badge reader, and the door opened behind me. A hand over my mouth. "The box," he said, and took it. I never saw his face, and I did not recognise his voice. I reported it. All that day, somebody was behind me.

**Helen Shaw, Wednesday `2026-02-04`.** Around 11:10 I took morphine from the `Drug Reserve`. Then I took a bag to the `Waste Room`. I heard the badge reader, and somebody came in after me. He pushed me into the wall and took the box. He took only the box. My bag and my telephone stayed on the floor. I never saw his face, and I did not recognise his voice. I reported it. All that day, somebody was behind me.

**Grace Mensah, Thursday `2026-02-05`.** Just before 16:00, I took morphine from the `Drug Reserve`. Then the `Loading Bay`. The shutter to the street was down: it is closed from 10:00 in the morning. The badge reader, the door, then his arm. He took the box. I never saw his face or recognised his voice. I reported it. All that day, somebody was behind me.
text:
**Amira Saleh, lunes `2026-02-02`.** Hacia las 15:30 saqué morfina de la reserva de medicamentos (`Drug Reserve`). Luego entré sola en el almacén de suministros (`Supply Room`). Unos minutos después oí el lector de tarjetas y la puerta se abrió a mi espalda. Una mano sobre la boca. «La caja», dijo, y se la llevó. Nunca le vi la cara y no reconocí su voz. Denuncié el robo. Durante todo ese día, alguien estuvo detrás de mí.

**Helen Shaw, miércoles `2026-02-04`.** Hacia las 11:10 saqué morfina de la reserva de medicamentos (`Drug Reserve`). Luego llevé una bolsa al cuarto de residuos (`Waste Room`). Oí el lector de tarjetas y alguien entró detrás de mí. Me empujó contra la pared y se llevó la caja. Solo se llevó la caja. Mi bolso y mi teléfono se quedaron en el suelo. Nunca le vi la cara y no reconocí su voz. Denuncié el robo. Durante todo ese día, alguien estuvo detrás de mí.

**Grace Mensah, jueves `2026-02-05`.** Justo antes de las 16:00, saqué morfina de la reserva de medicamentos (`Drug Reserve`). Luego el muelle de carga (`Loading Bay`). La persiana que da a la calle estaba bajada: está cerrada desde las 10:00 de la mañana. El lector de tarjetas, la puerta, luego su brazo. Se llevó la caja. Nunca le vi la cara ni reconocí su voz. Denuncié el robo. Durante todo ese día, alguien estuvo detrás de mí.

note: dossier "The Hospital Stalker" · document `how-to-answer` — title

source:
Once you have the name, return that person's row from `staff_badges`.

For example, if you think the answer is Amira Saleh, type this:

```sql
SELECT *
FROM staff_badges
WHERE holder = 'Amira Saleh'
```
text:
Cuando tengas el nombre, devuelve la fila de esa persona de `staff_badges`.

Por ejemplo, si crees que la respuesta es Amira Saleh, escribe esto:

```sql
SELECT *
FROM staff_badges
WHERE holder = 'Amira Saleh'
```

source:
Badge and code.

The code is given to the 7 staff whose `role` is `Nurse`. The `Pharmacist` has his own key. He fills the `Drug Reserve` in the evening. Nobody else gets in.
text:
Tarjeta y código.

El código se entrega a los 7 miembros del personal cuyo `role` es `Nurse`. El farmacéutico (`Pharmacist`) tiene su propia llave. Llena la `Drug Reserve` por la tarde. Nadie más entra.

source:
**16:48, `Linen Room`.** Owen Clarke goes in. 2 officers are already inside.

**16:50.** Colin Marsh badges in behind him and shuts the door. Arrested. No resistance.

**In his coat:** the box of morphine taken from Grace Mensah on Thursday.
text:
**16:48, `Linen Room`.** Owen Clarke entra. 2 agentes están ya dentro.

**16:50.** Colin Marsh pasa la tarjeta tras él y cierra la puerta. Detenido. Sin resistencia.

**En su abrigo:** la caja de morfina sustraída a Grace Mensah el jueves.
